explanation: Fires only at D1, at about 10, when the previous trial was a2 that reached S2 by the common transition and was rewarded, and the agent has already been choosing a2 for a few trials; it is weaker (about 7-9) right after an unrewarded trial and near 0-2 on the first a2 trial after switching or late in the episode (trial 80 onward). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, after any a1 choice, after a rare transition (S1 reached), and after no reward.
